architecture.androidRole: platform effects and Compose rendering only

rules: VIEW THUMBNAIL selects an available THUMBNAIL or VIDEO_COVER; PHOTO/GIF without one may select a supported raster ORIGINAL with delivery_mode OSS_IMAGE_THUMBNAIL, while a validated PHOTO image/svg+xml ORIGINAL up to 5 MiB may use ORIGINAL_RESOURCE
VIEW DETAIL selects the exact image ORIGINAL for photo/GIF/static media and retains the preview/cover path for VIDEO
STREAM selects only PREVIEW or DYNAMIC_PREVIEW
ORIGINAL_RESOURCE downloads are checked for final byte length and SHA-256 before use

OSS_IMAGE_THUMBNAIL is a non-persisted transformed response: Core verifies the short-lived signed HTTPS grant, image MIME type and maximum_output_size (5 MiB); its bytes are not compared with the source object SHA-256
localMapping: Core may enrich private-media list and detail snapshots with nullable localPlatformAssetRef and localSourceUri
A private-media save receipt is usable only when its content revision and resource-set digest match current private metadata; Android validates its MediaStore entry before completion

Photo/GIF/static detail rendering tries a readable MediaStore mapping, then an integrity-checked account-scoped app-private file named exactly mediaId; if neither is usable the local mapping remains null, while video keeps its cover/preview path and the private grid remains thumbnail-only
